import re,html,pathlib
t=pathlib.Path('products/research/catalogue-alt/litextension-pricing.html').read_text(errors='replace')
t=re.sub(r'(?s)<script.*?</script>|<style.*?</style>','',t)
s=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',t))
s=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',s)
out=[]
for kw in ['\$','USD','product','Product','CSV','variant','image','exclud','not include','All-in-One','Basic','Fully','refund','entities','per ']:
  for m in re.finditer(kw,s):
    out.append(kw+' | '+s[max(0,m.start()-160):m.end()+160])
seen=set();res=[]
for o in out:
  k=o[-200:]
  if k in seen: continue
  seen.add(k);res.append(o)
p=pathlib.Path('products/research/catalogue-alt/litextension-extract.txt');p.write_text('LEN '+str(len(s))+'\n'+'\n'.join(res[:120]))
print(len(s),len(res))
